# Patient.info

> Patient.info is a trusted UK health information platform providing evidence-based medical guidance, symptom checking tools, and pharmaceutical references for both patients and healthcare professionals.

Patient.info serves as a comprehensive health information resource developed by qualified medical professionals including GPs and specialists. The platform combines patient education materials with clinical tools and calculators, making it a dual-purpose resource for public health literacy and professional medical reference.

## Key Topics

- Symptom Checker
- Medical Information
- Patient Education
- Clinical Resources
- Health Topics
- Pharmaceutical Reference
- Health Calculators
- NHS-Recommended
- Digestive Health
- Heart Health
- Diabetes Management
- Cancer Information
- Respiratory Health
- Pediatric Health
- Mental Health

## Core Platform

- [Patient.info: Health Information and Symptom Checker](https://patient.info): Homepage: Health information, symptom checker, and medical tools for patients and professionals.
- [Health Topics](https://patient.info/health): Directory of health topics covering digestive health, skin, women's health, sexual health.
- [Medical Professional Hub](https://patient.info/doctor): Evidence-based clinical guidance and resources for UK healthcare professionals and GPs.

## Medical Reference & Tools

- [Medicine Information (A-Z)](https://patient.info/medicine): A-Z pharmaceutical reference database with medication information and drug interactions.
- [Patient Health Tools & Clinical Calculators](https://patient.info/medical-calculators): Free health calculators including BMI, pregnancy due date, and mental health assessments.

## Major Health Conditions

- [Cancer: Types, Symptoms, Screening, Diagnosis](https://patient.info/cancer): Comprehensive cancer information on types, symptoms, screening, diagnosis, and treatment.
- [Diabetes: Types, Advice, and Information](https://patient.info/diabetes): Diabetes management guide covering Type 1, Type 2, symptoms, treatment, and lifestyle.
- [Heart Health and Blood Vessels](https://patient.info/heart-health): Cardiovascular health hub on heart disease, blood pressure, cholesterol, and heart conditions.

## Body Systems & Conditions

- [Chest and Lungs: Conditions and Diseases](https://patient.info/chest-lungs): Respiratory health hub with guidance on asthma, COPD, coughs, and lung diseases.
- [Digestive Health](https://patient.info/digestive-health): Gastrointestinal health hub with medical advice on IBS, indigestion, and bowel disorders.
- [Brain and Nerves: Disorders and Problems](https://patient.info/brain-nerves): Neurological conditions guide covering dementia, epilepsy, strokes, and brain injuries.
- [Bones, Joints and Muscles](https://patient.info/bones-joints-muscles): Musculoskeletal health hub with guidance on arthritis, bone, and joint conditions.
- [Ears, Nose and Throat](https://patient.info/ear-nose-throat): ENT health information on ear infections, sinusitis, snoring, and throat conditions.
- [Eye Health: Conditions, Disorders and Diseases](https://patient.info/eye-care): Eye health hub covering vision problems, blurred vision, dry eyes, and eye diseases.
- [Allergies, Blood and Immune System](https://patient.info/allergies-blood-immune): Medical guide on allergies, allergic reactions, blood conditions, and immune system.

## Wellness & Lifestyle

- [Healthy living](https://patient.info/healthy-living): Wellness guide covering diet, exercise, sleep, addiction support, and smoking cessation.
- [General health](https://patient.info/general-health-and-lifestyle): General health information on wellness, lifestyle, and healthy living practices.

## Special Populations

- [Children's Health](https://patient.info/childrens-health): Pediatric health information on nappy rash, fever, vaccinations, and children's conditions.
- [Foot Care](https://patient.info/foot-care): Foot care guide on gout, blisters, broken toes, and diabetic foot problems.
